existing local multiplayer and arrest evidence packs

claims.claim: Multiplayer escape options and required item locations vary between matches.
Starting an escape sequence creates major noise and alerts Michael to the location.
Storm Cellar/Cellar, Sedan/Car, Outer Gate/Escape Fence, and Police Wagon are candidate current-build route families.
Storm Cellar blockers and follow-up tools vary by cellar; exact variants need direct prompt evidence.
Outer Gate candidate recipe is Fuse plus either Key or Bolt Cutter.
Sedan candidate requirements are Fuel, Repair Kit, and Sedan Key; interaction order and failure behavior are unverified.
Existing local Arrest evidence shows a POLICE WAGON CALLED HUD cue and police arrival countdown.
The exact Police Wagon escape unlock threshold is unknown.
Route discovery, destination-marker behavior, and reasons a route may not appear on the map are unknown.
Warned residents can be directed toward escape objectives; exact command and completion behavior require current-build capture.
Exact exit capacity/use limits are unknown; do not publish fixed 3/4/5 values.
Sedan destination marker missing and Cellar boards/Fire Axe interaction failures are current-build observed reports only.

capture_tasks: Capture source-native prompt/state/next-action frames for Cellar variants, Outer Gate variants, Sedan sequence, Police Wagon escape, map marker, and resident evacuation.
Run enough current-build matches to test capacity/use behavior without converting a single run into a universal rule.
Preserve source-native originals and bind each selected frame to one claim/state/next action.

verification_log.observed: Official narration says civilians guide residents to one of several possible randomized escapes around the map.
Official narration identifies points of interest, resident NPCs, lootable containers, and possible escape routes.
Official narration ties escape planning to lootable containers/key items and says item/escape locations change from match to match.
Official narration says initiating escape sequences generates tremendous noise.
Bolt Cutters pickup is visible; no Cellar or Outer Gate interaction prompt/state is proven.
Players verbally discuss finding a repair kit for the car; no repair interaction or Sedan HUD sequence is visible.
Players mention Bolt Cutters and inability to grab them; no Gate/Cellar state or successful interaction is proven.
Existing Arrest evidence shows POLICE WAGON CALLED and arrival countdown; it does not prove escape entry or unlock threshold.
No supplied-route interaction evidence found in available captions; index was 640x360.
